# Games by CodeLove (games.codelove.in)

> 14+ free 3D WebGL browser games built with Three.js and CodeLove's free GLB model library — play instantly on PC or mobile with no download or sign-up.

## Playable Games
- [Patti Veedu](https://games.codelove.in/patti-veedu/): 3D horror puzzle inside Grandma's house.
- [Aisle Zero](https://games.codelove.in/aisle-zero/): Supermarket horror stealth game.
- [Cannon Cove](https://games.codelove.in/cannon-cove/): Naval cannon battle and pirate trading across open seas.
- [Turbo Karts](https://games.codelove.in/turbo-karts/): 3D kart racing with drift boosts.
- [Skate Rush](https://games.codelove.in/skate-rush/): Endless 3D street skating runner.
- [Crypt Knight](https://games.codelove.in/crypt-knight/): Dungeon action roguelite.
- [Kingdom Clash](https://games.codelove.in/kingdom-clash/), [Sky Hop](https://games.codelove.in/sky-hop/), [Saucer Siege](https://games.codelove.in/saucer-siege/), [Order Up!](https://games.codelove.in/order-up/), [Siege Smash](https://games.codelove.in/siege-smash/), [Beat Street](https://games.codelove.in/beat-street/), [Putt Paradise](https://games.codelove.in/putt-paradise/), [Hex Haven](https://games.codelove.in/hex-haven/)
